dt-option.name: stateRestore.canCreate
dt-option.summary: Set if the end user is allowed to create new states

type.description: When `false` the end user will not be able to create new states. When `true`, they will.

dt-option.default: The end user will be able to create new states.
dt-option.description:
StateRestore offers the end user to create new states not only through the `-button stateCreate` button, but also through the sub-buttons for states which are shared in, or predefined by duplicating them.
While it is trivial to leave out the `-button stateCreate` button, if you don't want the end user to be able to create new states from others that are available to them (i.e. you just want to provide a list of states that you control), this option is available to disable that ability.

example.title: Provide a single state and the end user cannot add their own or duplicate
